text: 首都禁飞区政策实施后，市投资促进局抢抓京津冀地区低空经济企业转移机遇，“点对点”精准对接意向外迁企业需求，联合临漳县快速承接，成功推动智能物流与特种作业无人机高新技术企业北京天隼创翼科技有限公司落户邯郸。项目主要包括“华北区域总部+总装制造+试飞测试+运维培训+场景运营”五个板块，分三阶段实施，先期占用4000平方米厂房，预计年产垂起固定翼无人机300架。10月12日下午，该项目首批设备顺利进场，成为首都禁飞区政策以来全市首家北京低空经济产业转移落地企业。（投资邯郸微信公号）
text_en: After the capital's no-fly zone policy took effect, the Municipal Investment Promotion Bureau seized the opportunity of low-altitude economy enterprises relocating within the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, carried out precise point-to-point matching of the needs of enterprises intending to relocate, and worked with Linzhang County to quickly take them in, successfully bringing Beijing Tiansun Chuangyi Technology Co., Ltd., a high-tech enterprise specializing in smart logistics and special-operation drones, to Handan. The project mainly includes five segments: "North China regional headquarters + final assembly manufacturing + test flight testing + operation and maintenance training + scenario operations," implemented in three phases, initially occupying a 4,000-square-meter factory and expected to produce 300 vertical takeoff and landing fixed-wing drones annually. On the afternoon of October 12, the project's first batch of equipment entered the site smoothly, making it the city's first Beijing low-altitude economy industrial relocation enterprise to land since the capital's no-fly zone policy. (Invest Handan WeChat official account)
